Walk the tree-lined boulevard of First Street SE, once known as the Esplanade, and discover the stories of Medicine Hat's earliest settlers. Marvel at the well-preserved architecture and delve into the lives of the people who once called this area home. Each tour is unique, with our guides sharing their own anecdotes and memories, offering you a true sense of the neighborhood's past.
